title: make tourism dates a date picker or make them editable

comments.body: It was on purpose because too complex to have the underlying dataset compliant with non-fixed dates. Happy if we find an alternative :)
Yes I remember that (on purpose). Maybe we can just remove them or gray them more explicitly. It seems right now they could work but the click is not working (+ add a tooltip "this is just a demo")
